issue.subject: BlueStore write_v2: reusing a same-txn released AU lets a stale deferred write overwrite a later direct write
issue.description:
|Kind|data corruption (detected as csum EIO; silent with @bluestore_csum_type=none@)| |Severity|major for affected configs| |Config|non-default: @bluestore_write_v2=true@ (default false; needed for recompression), @min_alloc_size > block_size@ (defaults are 4K for HDD and SSD, so legacy 16K/64K OSDs or explicit setting), @prefer_deferred_size > 0@ (HDD default 64K; SSD default 0, so SSD is not affected). The gtest widens the window with @bluestore_deferred_batch_ops=1000@ and @bluestore_max_defer_interval=1000@; the live-OSD reproduction uses the default deferred settings| |Real-world|*Confirmed on a live OSD* with plain librados write/zero ops (write_v2, 16K min_alloc HDD OSD): object unreadable after OSD restart| |Affected|main (write_v2 since PR #54504). Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a; the v1 write path passes the same test| h3. Summary @Writer::_defer_or_allocate()@ (Writer.cc:1312-1336) reuses space released *in the same transaction* (@released@) as the target of a deferred write, and the new blob marks the rest of the allocation unit unused (@add_unused_all()@, Writer.cc:512-514, only when @min_alloc_size != block_size@). A later small write into that unused part is issued as a direct aio write. An older deferred write to the same disk bytes, from an earlier txc and still in the deferred queue, is applied afterwards and overwrites the new data. v1 avoids this by releasing space to the allocator only after all preceding txcs on the sequencer have finished their deferred writes (@_txc_finish@, BlueStore.cc:15194-15200). h3. Reproduction gtests @StoreTestSpecificAUSize.DeferredReuseRaceV1@ (control) and @...V2@ (@test.cc@), min_alloc_size 16K: # write 16K @A@; # write 8K~4K @B@ (deferred overwrite, stays queued); # zero 4K~12K; # write 0~4K @C@ (the AU is released and reused as a deferred target); # write 8K~4K @D@ (direct write into the unused part); # remount and read 0~12K. h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) V1: @[ OK ]@. V2: 
_verify_csum bad crc32c/0x1000 checksum at blob offset 0x2000, got 0x9042a7fd, expected 0x45dcb42b, device location [0x436000~1000], logical extent 0x2000~1000, object #-1:d3a31c15:::RaceObj:head#
store_test.cc:12427: Failure
Expected equality of these values:
  12288
  r
    Which is: -5
@0x9042a7fd@ is the crc of the step-2 data @B@; the debug log shows the reuse (@_defer_or_allocate released=0x4000 need=0x4000 deferred@) and the stale deferred write (@_deferred_submit_unlock seq 1 0x436000~1000@). h3. Live OSD reproduction vstart 1 OSD (HDD-type file device) with @bluestore_write_v2=true@, @bluestore_min_alloc_size_hdd=16384@, other options default; librados: write_full 16K @A@, write 4K @B@ at 8K, zero 4K~12K, write 4K @C@ at 0, write 4K @D@ at 8K; restart the OSD; read (@common/live-scenarios.sh 03@). 
1 write_full A 16K
2 write B at 8K (deferred overwrite)
3 zero 4K~12K
4 write C at 0 (AU released + reused)
5 write D at 8K (into unused part)
read before restart ok: True
read after restart FAILED: [errno 110] RADOS timed out (Ioctx.read(p): failed to read race)
bluestore(/root/bh/vs/dev/osd0) _verify_csum bad crc32c/0x1000 checksum at blob offset 0x2000, got 0x9042a7fd, expected 0x45dcb42b, device location [0x19062000~1000], logical extent 0x0~1000, object #
bluestore(/root/bh/vs/dev/osd0) _verify_csum bad crc32c/0x1000 checksum at blob offset 0x2000, got 0x9042a7fd, expected 0x45dcb42b, device location [0x19062000~1000], logical extent 0x2000~1000, objec
h3. Expected The read returns @C | zeros | D@, as with the v1 write path. h3. Suggested fix Do not reuse space released in the current txn while older deferred IO on the sequencer may still target it (mirror v1: release to the allocator only after preceding deferred writes complete), or make later writes into such blobs deferred as well. h3. Reproducer files * "test.cc":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/03-write-v2-deferred-reuse-race/test.cc * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
